adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` without any try/catch. If `reqBody.keys` is malformed (not decryptable) or decrypts to non-JSON, `symmetricDecrypt` and/or `JSON.parse` will throw and the request will bubble up as an unhandled exception, resulting in a 500 rather than a controlled 4xx response.
